text: Velocity is a fork of Drift Protocol v2 taken at Drift SDK v2.163.0-beta.0. It is a new onchain program deployment with its own program ID and its own SDK package, not an upgrade of Drift in place. The Drift program is paused, no onchain state carries over, and every PDA address differs from Drift's. (high confidence)
keywords: Drift and Velocity SDK and data API
